cases.excerpt: rule team_member(team) / current_user in team.members; later used for page visibility and operation admission
cases.task_intent: Only team members may read or change their supplies.
cases.gold_reason: The named helper is reused for record read access and operation admission; one construct does not replace both.

cases.excerpt: page Supplies(team); state search: Text = ""; search_input search; list visible_supplies
cases.task_intent: Give team members a supply list searchable by name within the current view.
cases.gold_reason: The requested list has a documented search selector; this does not validate the surrounding page or query.

cases.guess: rule Shift may be read only when currentMember exists
cases.excerpt: Shift {team: Team, title: Text, status: Open | Filled}; rule Shift may be read only when currentMember exists
cases.task_intent: Team members may browse shifts; outsiders cannot read them.
cases.gold_reason: This is a stored-record read grant, which policy owns.

cases.guess: rule status == Open implies assignee == none
cases.excerpt: Shift {status: Open | Filled = Open, assignee: Teammate?}; rule status == Open implies assignee == none
cases.task_intent: Open shifts have no assignee; filling assigns an active teammate.
cases.gold_reason: It states a predicate that must hold for every accepted stored row state.

cases.guess: rule purpose and amount may change only while status is Draft

cases.task_intent: Submitting freezes purpose and amount through every mutation path.
cases.gold_reason: It protects selected fields from writes once the row leaves Draft.
